name: How long does a tankless water heater replacement installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a tankless water heater replacement installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a tankless water heater replacement typically ranges from a few hours to a full day, depending on the complexity of the job. A direct replacement of an existing tankless unit might be quicker. However, if you are converting from a tank-style heater or require significant modifications to gas, water, or venting lines, the process will take longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation can take a few hours to a full day, depending on complexity and whether it's a direct replacement or a conversion from a tank-style unit.
